выстроиться.gloss: to line up, form a queue

meanings.en: to line up, form a queue
meanings.note: Form a single file or line. Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'строиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to line up, form a queue', paired with 'выстраиваться'.

examples.trans: If he becomes mayor, a whole line will form!

examples.text: Утром перед магазином выстроилась длинная очередь.
examples.trans: In the morning a long queue formed in front of the shop.
